# Uluwatu Paradise by Next Gen Home (NGH Property Group)

> Premium real estate development in South Bali, built with Dutch standards, structure, and long-term vision.

Uluwatu Paradise is a high-end property development project in the Uluwatu area of South Bali, Indonesia. It is developed by Next Gen Home (NGH Property Group), a Dutch-Indonesian real estate company.

## The Project

Uluwatu Paradise offers three apartment types:
- **Studio Apartment** — compact luxury living
- **One Bedroom Apartment** — ideal for couples and digital nomads
- **Two Bedroom Apartment** — spacious family or investment option

All units are designed with a blend of authentic Balinese architecture and Western functionality, using natural local materials for timeless quality.

## Amenities

- Private Gym — fully equipped fitness center on-site
- Co-Working Space — high-speed internet, ergonomic workstations, climate control
- Sauna — wellness and relaxation facility
- Jacuzzi — outdoor hot tub with tropical surroundings
- Rooftop Terrace — panoramic sunset views over Uluwatu
- Swimming Pool — crystal-clear tropical oasis surrounded by greenery

## Why Choose Paradise

- Dutch-standard construction quality and transparency
- On-site development team with hands-on involvement
- Premium location in Uluwatu, South Bali
- Long-term investment value with professional property management
- Legal compliance and full transparency for international buyers

## Location

Jl. Pantai Balangan, Ungasan, Kec. Kuta Sel., Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80361, Indonesia

The property is located in the prestigious Uluwatu area of South Bali, known for its world-class surf breaks, clifftop temples, and luxury lifestyle.

## The Team

NGH Property Group is a Dutch-founded company with on-the-ground presence in Bali. The team combines Dutch business standards with local Balinese expertise.
